content: Even the fool possesses one sacred spark of purpose under heaven.
author: Japanese Proverbs
explanation: Society loves ranking humans on a uniform ladder of prestige, condemning those who do not fit narrow metrics. Yet in the grand architecture of life, every being has a distinct, unrepeatable gift that no genius can replicate. Honor your unique melody.
practicalInsight: Stop measuring your worth against someone else's highlight reel. Double down on the one honest thing you do with genuine love.
reflectionPrompt: What quirky, humble gift do you possess that you have undervalued because society doesn't hand out trophies for it?
